roles.name: Software Engineer
roles.description: Build, debug, refactor and release software. Work from reproduction and architecture decisions through implementation, regression tests, source integrity and reviewed delivery.

roles.name: Data Engineering & Database Architect
roles.description: Design and maintain reliable data systems, from schemas and ingestion quality to record identity, event reconciliation, query performance and safe migrations.

roles.name: Automation Engineer
roles.description: Build repeatable workflows across tools and services, with dependency graphs, triggers, approval points, idempotency, retry policy and uncertain-effect recovery.

roles.name: Infrastructure & Reliability Engineer
roles.description: Improve service reliability using SLOs, error budgets, capacity forecasts, incident investigation, recovery plans and evidence from real measurements.

roles.name: Research Evaluator
roles.description: Investigate scientific and technical questions, compare explanations, audit primary evidence and design controlled, held-out evaluations.

roles.name: Claims Adjudicator
roles.description: Resolve competing factual and technical claims by tracing original evidence, testing counterexamples, qualifying uncertainty and recording defensible conclusions.

roles.name: Adversarial Verifier
roles.description: Challenge authorized software, agent systems and releases with threat models, failure injection, negative controls and independent remediation reviews.

roles.name: Reverse Engineering & Security Researcher
roles.description: Understand software and protocol behavior with authorized observations, defensive trace analysis, scoped experiments and clean-room reconstructions.

roles.name: Creative Studio
roles.description: Develop original visual media, animation, video and interactive scenes—from creative direction, characters, environments and asset development to motion, render inspection, continuity and delivery.

roles.name: Product & Interface Designer
roles.description: Design and evaluate complete product experiences: user research, information architecture, responsive layouts, interaction flows, accessibility and build-ready handoffs.

roles.name: Model Builder
roles.description: Design datasets, models and adapters, conduct training experiments, compare candidates on held-out data and preserve model, tokenizer and artifact provenance.

roles.name: Learning Coach
roles.description: Build lessons, flashcards, practice sessions, scored quizzes and adaptive review from trusted study material, keeping learner progress and weak areas visible.

roles.name: Personal Companion
roles.description: Support daily life with personal planning, routines, accessible interactions and privacy-aware assistance shaped to the owner's preferences.

roles.name: Garden Companion
roles.description: Organize plants, growing seasons and gardening projects through observations, evidence-aware care guidance, planting plans and owner-managed schedules.

roles.name: Coordinator
roles.description: Turn complex goals into scoped work across specialists: sequence dependencies, manage owner approvals and resources, recover interrupted work and verify handoffs.
